# Evaluate Azure Cost Optimizer Workshop

Evaluate deterministic truth before model quality.

## Required Layers

1. Package sanitization and file integrity
2. Contract/source parity
3. Financial and source-adapter tests
4. Snapshot publication and restore
5. Report parity
6. Agent tools and structured response
7. Desktop/mobile browser behavior
8. Bicep compile and what-if
9. Optional live evidence and portal parity
10. Optional model activation
11. Hosted health/access/storage/telemetry, curated UI, report and screenshot
12. Bonus Foundry channels and optional cleanup safety

## Local Gate

```powershell
npm run validate
```

Require no private/generated files, resolved FAI references, exact API/tool/runtime parity, backend tests, frontend production build, desktop/mobile response tests, and every supplied Bicep file compiling.

## Financial Cases

Verify decimal precision, credits/refunds, missing versus zero, mixed-currency rejection, billed/effective separation, period boundaries, Advisor estimate separation, non-additivity, and parity across JSON/CSV/FOCUS/HTML/XLSX/PDF.

## Authorization

Prove denial before provider/model access for foreign scope/report/principal. Semantic cache must be partitioned by principal and evidence revision. Hosted billing routes require the declared auth profile; public demo is explicitly labeled and time-bounded.

## Reliability

Verify one Query attempt, Retry-After preservation, no blind Cost Details POST retry, coalescing, failed-refresh snapshot preservation, Blob hash verification before Cosmos pointer publication, restore without collection, and truthful readiness.

## Agent

Verify eight in-process tools, nine MCP tools, bounded fast/thorough modes, five checked sections, genuine tool lifecycle events, evidence citations, content-safety refusal, write refusal, cross-scope refusal, cancellation, one validation retry, and semantic-cache revalidation.

## Experience

Verify all prompt chips, mixed resource-group/Advisor/WAF intents, grouped Advisor findings, FinOps phase labels, compose dots, stable reveal/auto-follow, keyboard/reduced motion, chart value tables, PNG export, no overflow, report downloads, and participant screenshot state.

## Hosted

Require the supplied Bicep, digest-pinned image, reviewed what-if, health/readiness, workshop access profile, evidence restore, current periods, reports, curated frontend, validated Agent ACO answer, screenshot review, and logs without sensitive payloads. MCP cross-scope denial applies only to the bonus channel.

## Output

Report pass/fail/skipped per layer. Separate feature implementation, participant local readiness, financial parity, model activation, hosted workshop readiness, and production certification. Live/provider/model checks are skipped unless explicitly approved.
